lines: A tiny magician performs a magic show on YOUR real table.
You are his volunteer: bare hands, no controllers.

segments.do: A trapdoor opens in your real table.
segments.shows: Scene understanding finds the table and anchors the stage

segments.do: Don't touch. Just LOOK at one card.
segments.shows: Head gaze picks it. No cursor, no pointer

segments.do: You looked at the diamond. He knows.
Pinch the coin he lends you.
segments.shows: Hand tracking: pinch to grab

segments.do: Carry it. Set it down anywhere.
segments.shows: Pinch, carry, release on the real tabletop

segments.do: Lean in. The table opens under YOUR coin.
segments.shows: A theatre beneath your real table, through passthrough

segments.do: He catches it far below the table.
The trapdoor closes. The table is whole.
Open your palm.
segments.shows: Palm-up pose detection

segments.do: The coin appears in your hand.
segments.shows: It rides your palm as you move

segments.do: He teaches you a real trick: the Vanish.
segments.shows: Learn it now. You will need it later

segments.do: Close your fist... open it. Gone!
segments.shows: Fist and open-hand poses

segments.do: "Remember that move."
Something reaches out of the trapdoor...
...and steals the coin. The lights flicker.
segments.shows: Your real room dims around the show

segments.do: Hold the trapdoor shut with both hands!
segments.shows: Two-handed hold, tracked while it bangs

segments.do: It bursts out. He comes back possessed.
segments.shows: His giant shadow is thrown on your real wall

segments.do: Banish it with the Vanish: fist, then open!
segments.shows: The lesson pays off

segments.do: He's himself again. And your coin is back.
Cover the velvet case with a flat hand.
segments.shows: Palm-down cover gesture

segments.do: Lift: empty! Then where is your card?
Your diamond rises beside him.
segments.shows: The card you chose with your eyes

segments.do: You saved the show.
segments.shows: Velvet curtains drop over your real wall

segments.do: Nod to take a bow.
segments.shows: Head pose as input

segments.do: Come back: he knocks from the same spot.
segments.shows: Spatial anchor and saved progress. New tricks each night

segments.do: Any table, in rooms it was never tuned for.
segments.shows: Office

segments.shows: Living room
